title: Identify the European world-node drawing dispatch and mode producer
platforms: European source and retained Wine state evidence
changes: Trace the signed map delta reader to a 30-node drawing loop and its five-entry dispatch. Trace the scheduler and stage 9 initializers through the 256-entry outer switch, and identify the 52 remaining unowned dispatch and literal bytes as one family.
validation: Metadata unit 785naf3v passes 54 input guards and finds no mode 1 or registered stage 8, 9 or 10 in 45 selected retained EUR snapshots. It authenticates all 17 renderer literals and the three original direct call sites.
limitations: Ordinary execution requires a normal placement recording before stage 9. Inner dispatch publication, generated dispatch, original BIOS, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No new scene replay or performance measurement.
